name: UP Police Constable Practice Sets - Practice Test 2

questions.question: Which city is the administrative headquarters of Uttar Pradesh police?
questions.hint: The Police Headquarters of UP is located in Lucknow.

questions.question: What is the emergency helpline number for police in India?
questions.hint: 112 is the single emergency response number, which integrated 100 (police).

questions.question: Which district is the largest in Uttar Pradesh by area?
questions.hint: Lakhimpur Kheri is the largest district by area in Uttar Pradesh.

questions.question: The classical dance form of Uttar Pradesh is:
questions.hint: Kathak originated in northern India, primarily Uttar Pradesh.

questions.question: Who was the first Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh?
questions.hint: Govind Ballabh Pant was the first Chief Minister of UP.

questions.question: What is the official State Animal of Uttar Pradesh?
questions.hint: The Barasingha (Swamp Deer) is the state animal of UP.

questions.question: Which is the official State Flower of Uttar Pradesh?
questions.hint: Palash (Tesu) is designated as the state flower of UP.

questions.question: What is the total number of districts in Uttar Pradesh?
questions.hint: Uttar Pradesh is divided into 75 administrative districts grouped into 18 divisions.

questions.question: Uttar Pradesh shares its borders with how many Indian States and Union Territories?
questions.hint: UP shares borders with 8 states (Uttarakhand, Himachal, Haryana, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Bihar) and 1 UT (Delhi).

questions.question: Where is the main seat of the High Court of Judicature of Uttar Pradesh located?
questions.hint: The main seat is in Prayagraj, with a permanent bench in Lucknow.

questions.question: What is the total number of seats in the Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha) of Uttar Pradesh?
questions.hint: The UP Legislative Assembly consists of 403 elected members.

questions.question: Lal Bahadur Shastri International Airport in Uttar Pradesh is located at which city?
questions.hint: The airport is located in Babatpur near Varanasi.

questions.question: The historical monument "Buland Darwaza" in Uttar Pradesh is located at:
questions.hint: Buland Darwaza (Gate of Magnificence) was built by Akbar at Fatehpur Sikri.

questions.question: The holy site "Sarnath", where Buddha gave his first sermon, is near which city?
questions.hint: Sarnath is located 10 km northeast of Varanasi.

questions.question: Which type of soil covers the largest area in Uttar Pradesh?
questions.hint: UP lies in the fertile Indo-Gangetic plain, primarily covered by alluvial soils.
